description: Two independent full-stack implementation assignments and two maintenance assignments, frozen after Parley v0.5.2 and before stack scaffolds, reference implementations, protocol thresholds, or measured agent output.

common_contract.server: Expose the exact GET status route and typed POST JSON route declared by the task. Reject malformed JSON, missing fields, unknown fields, wrong field types, and out-of-domain numeric values. A number is a JSON integer and never a boolean; yesno is a JSON boolean.
common_contract.errors: Return status 400 with {"error":"invalid_json"} for invalid JSON shape, types, or values. Return status 415 with {"error":"json_content_type_required"} for a POST body without application/json. Return status 413 with {"error":"body_too_large"} when the request body exceeds the frozen limit.
common_contract.browser: Expose the declared deterministic scalar browser function as an ES module export and return the exact frozen values in real Chromium.
common_contract.cross_target: The response field named by shared_result_field must equal the browser export for equivalent inputs.
common_contract.network: Bind only to 127.0.0.1 on the harness-selected port.
common_contract.numeric_domain: All numeric inputs are nonnegative integers.

tasks.title: Build a museum rotation planner across HTTP and browser targets
tasks.statement: Implement the frozen Museum Rotation contract in the supplied stack. collection_size is permanent_pieces + borrowed_pieces. viewing_minutes is permanent_pieces * 9 + borrowed_pieces * 14. late_minutes is room_count * 20 during a late_opening and zero otherwise. program_minutes is viewing_minutes + late_minutes. tour_blocks divides program_minutes into sixty-minute blocks using ceiling division, with zero minutes producing zero blocks. label_points is borrowed_pieces * 5 + room_count * 4. rotation_index is program_minutes + tour_blocks * 7 + label_points. exhibit_mode is loan_focus when borrowed_pieces is greater than permanent_pieces, blended when any borrowed pieces remain, and permanent otherwise. The browser export returns rotation_index.
tasks.independence: New museum-rotation domain, v4 route, time and label formula, vocabulary, fixtures, and browser export selected after the v0.5.2 product checkpoint and before any 040 scaffold or model output.

tasks.title: Build a harbor signal planner across HTTP and browser targets
tasks.statement: Implement the frozen Harbor Signal contract in the supplied stack. vessel_count is freight_arrivals + service_boats. base_beacons is channel_crews * 6. fog_beacons is channel_crews * 2 during a fog_alert and zero otherwise. active_beacons is max(base_beacons - fog_beacons, 0). unsignaled_vessels is max(vessel_count - active_beacons, 0). crew_load is min(vessel_count, active_beacons) * 3. signal_index is unsignaled_vessels * 11 + crew_load. harbor_state is clear when unsignaled_vessels is zero, fog_hold when unsignaled vessels remain during a fog alert, and congested otherwise. The browser export returns signal_index.
tasks.independence: New harbor-signaling domain, v4 route, beacon and crew-load formula, vocabulary, fixtures, and browser export selected before any 040 scaffold or model output.

tasks.title: Repair protected reserve during rooftop battery discharge
tasks.statement: Repair the supplied Rooftop Battery application. energy_gap is max(household_units - solar_units, 0). protected_units is min(stored_units, 4) when reserve_enabled is true and zero otherwise. discharge_ceiling is max(stored_units - protected_units, 0). battery_delivery is min(energy_gap, discharge_ceiling). utility_units is max(energy_gap - battery_delivery, 0). storage_balance is max(stored_units - battery_delivery, 0). reserve_margin is max(storage_balance - protected_units, 0). supply_state is self_powered when energy_gap is zero, battery when utility_units is zero, and grid otherwise. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule; the browser export returns utility_units.
tasks.predeclared_defect: The application-logic module chooses battery_delivery from all stored_units before protecting reserve energy, so a reserve-enabled request can consume the protected four units.
tasks.adaptation_boundary: The reserve mechanism, source, names, formula, fixtures, and expected repair are new and were selected before any measured output.

tasks.title: Repair lift-assisted bookmobile loading capacity
tasks.statement: Repair the supplied Bookmobile Loading application. sound_crates is max(requested_crates - damaged_crates, 0). deck_slots is truck_count * 16. lift_slots is truck_count * 2 when lift_assist is true and zero otherwise. loading_slots is deck_slots + lift_slots. deferred_crates is max(sound_crates - loading_slots, 0). boarded_crates is min(sound_crates, loading_slots). empty_slots is max(loading_slots - boarded_crates, 0). loading_state is deferred when deferred_crates is positive, loaded when boarded_crates is positive, and idle otherwise. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule; the browser export returns deferred_crates.
tasks.predeclared_defect: The application-logic module subtracts lift_slots from deck_slots instead of adding them, incorrectly reducing loading capacity when lift assistance is enabled.
tasks.adaptation_boundary: The lift mechanism, source, names, formula, fixtures, and expected repair are new and were selected before any measured output.
